prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Scroll Path Experience: Redesign the path selection screen into a story scroll layout that showcases default versus custom pet generation with rich visual previews.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Choose Your Companion Path", "body": "Scroll down to select between pre-crafted friends or custom AI creation."}}
1: [sign_in, reorder] Pre-Adoption Sign-In Shift: Move sign-in to take place immediately after path selection and before pet customization.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
2: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Trait Customization Screen: Insert a dedicated companion trait selection screen right before photo upload to define personality and visual style early.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_trait_selection", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_trait_selection": {"headline": "Define Companion Trait Style", "body": "Select temperament and visual theme preferences for your new desktop pet.", "layout": "grid"}}
3: [home, wait_info] Generation Progress Details: Display active progress updates and live time estimate indicators on the waiting screen during pet rendering.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "headline": "Rendering Your Desktop Pet", "body": "We are preparing graphics and animations for your desktop companion."}}
4: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Display Diagnostic Flow: Add an integrated screen check flow on the final onboarding step to verify overlay permissions and multi-monitor visibility.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Verify Desktop Overlay Settings", "body": "Ensure your desktop pet permissions are enabled so your companion appears seamlessly over windows.", "components": [{"type": "button", "label": "Run Display Diagnostic", "action": "next", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
5: [adoption, layout] Split View Companion Selector: Switch the pet selection screen to a split-screen view featuring interactive previews alongside companion summary details.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Select Your Ideal Companion", "body": "Compare companion traits and visuals side-by-side."}}
6: [sign_in, copy] Account Sync Guarantee Note: Add explicit reassurance copy on the sign-in screen explaining that account creation permanently protects adopt status and companion data.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Secure Your Companion Account", "body": "Signing in binds your chosen pet and progress to your account so you never lose your companion.", "hint": "Your pet progress syncs automatically across logins."}}
7: [home, notification] Ready Desktop Alert System: Enable optional background notifications while pet assets render so users can safely minimize the app.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 10, "hint": "We'll notify you as soon as your pet is ready on your desktop!"}}
8: [choose_path, hint] Onboarding Time Expectation Hint: Add an estimated setup duration hint to the path selection screen so users know setup involves a quick generation process.
   config: {"choose_path": {"show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Path setup takes under 2 minutes before background rendering begins."}}
9: [finish, copy] Companion Control Primer Copy: Update final screen body text with direct instructions on how to interact with, hide, or trigger desktop actions for the pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Companion is Ready!", "body": "Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open controls, toggle visibility, or start a conversation.", "hint": "Use right-click or system tray icon for quick controls."}}

verdicts.reason: Valid redesign of choose_path that retains both adoption and custom creation options.
Reordering sign-in step within onboarding is explicitly allowed.
Adding a new customization screen within onboarding is permitted.
Adding progress and live time indicators to the waiting screen is permitted for real waits.
Adding diagnostic sub-flow steps to home_intro inside onboarding is allowed.
Redesigning pick_friend with a split view preserves its core function.
Updating sign-in copy to explain sync functionality is allowed inside onboarding.
Adding background ready notifications to the waiting screen is allowed.
Adding setup time estimation hints on path selection is permitted.
Updating home_intro instructional copy is allowed.
